$comment-background: Chromium's default background policy is left ALONE — no EcoQoS / renderer-backgrounding / timer-throttling overrides. Fighting the scheduler with flags was tried alongside per-view process isolation and both were reverted: a throttled-then-frozen background renderer came back blank or with stale content. Views share a renderer with visible content, which is what keeps them scheduled. Keeping blotters live while hidden is handled at the app level instead (widgets-react dormancy policy).
$comment-scrollbars: Native scrollbars use the platform default (Win11 Fluent: thin rounded thumb that expands on hover) — fully composited, and AG Grid gutters self-size via the grid's runtime scrollbarWidth probe either way. To switch to the classic always-thick square style instead, append FluentScrollbar,FluentOverlayScrollbar,OverlayScrollbar to the ONE comma-separated --disable-features flag (repeated flags don't merge). Arbitrary widths would require ::-webkit-scrollbar styling, which forces main-thread painted scrollbars — deliberately ruled out (see design-system styles/scrollbar.css AG exemption).
$comment-devtools: devtools_port + --remote-debugging-port together expose the OpenFin runtime to Chrome DevTools. Open chrome://inspect#devices in a separate Chrome window and click 'Configure...' → add 'localhost:9091', then SharedWorkers (data-services) appear under 'Other'.

platform.$comment-fdc3: Enable the FDC3 API (window.fdc3) for EVERY view/window the platform creates. Without this window.fdc3 is undefined, so the grid color-link transport (useFdc3Channel → useGridContextLink) silently no-ops and color-linked grids never exchange selection context. The dock 'Link' button joins windows to interop context groups; fdc3 broadcast/addContextListener wrap interop.setContext/addContextHandler over that group.

customSettings.$comment-useRest: Master switch for REST mode. true + non-empty configServiceRestUrl → every ConfigManager in the platform writes to the REST server first, mirrors to Dexie, queues pendingSync on transient failures. false (or unset) → local Dexie only. Flip this single boolean to switch the whole platform between local and REST.
